title: Modus Analysis Receipt
description: Publication receipt for one immutable analysis bundle. The two digests are the complete identity needed to reopen it; coverage, diagnostics, and timings are bounded operational summaries rather than stored evidence.

status.description: Only fully published and verified bundles receive a receipt.

bundleDigest.description: Content identity of the published analysis bundle.

baselineDigest.description: Content identity of the repository snapshot analyzed by the bundle.

coverage.description: Bounded counts describing which inputs and evidence layers were covered.

diagnostics.description: Machine-readable summary of degraded or unavailable evidence.

timings.description: Optional stage timing telemetry in milliseconds; it is not part of bundle identity.
